We are currently seeking an Electrical Engineering Design Professional to join our team in Houston. In this role, you will be responsible for creating drawings using a variety of tools including …
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develops, modifies, and reviews Revit models of electrical engineering systems and components according to established standards and Revit modeling techniques, based on input from the electrical …
Develops one line diagrams, riser diagrams, schedules, and similar project documents using 2D Revit.
Organizes and maintains Revit models and documents for multiple projects.
Works closely with project team and assists to complete projects on aggressive schedules.
Performs all work in a clear, complete, and accurate manner.
Uses Revit to check the design for interferences with other building elements.
Utilizes knowledge and experience in applying modeling principles for drawings.
Utilizes knowledge and experience in applying drafting principles for drawings.
